Office Capacity Assessment Dashboard

February 24, 2026

Purpose

This dashboard allows users to view data related to the capacity of office space within the PSPC-administered office portfolio, including number of primary workpoints currently available.

It contains data for Office space located within Office Assets only.

Non-office assets and Special Purpose Space within Office assets are not reflected in this dashboard.

Surplus (Deficit) by Asset

This section shows the net position of individual assets based on selected filters (region and/or partner). The different measures (e.g m2r, workpoints, surplus or deficit) are aggregated as the asset level for all partners accommodated at that address.

To view the measure for a given partner, select an asset by clicking on a table row. Press the Escape button to reset the view.

Dictionary

Portfolio Overview

This section summarizes the ongoing assessment of primary workpoints across the PSPC office portfolio, viewable nationally or by region. Data, provided by regional teams to the National Strategic Portfolio Planning sector (NSPP), is gathered through site visits and floorplan reviews. Filters applied here carry over to other dashboard sections.

Assessment completion data is calculated as follows:

  1. Amount of Rentable Square Meters Assessed: Total rentable square metres for all fully or partially assessed floors.
  2. Number of Assets Assessed: Total assets where all floors are either assigned a workpoint count or deemed not requiring assessment (e.g., storage or conference floors, etc.).
  3. Number of Floors Assessed: Total floors assessed, meaning each has a workpoint count or is identified as not requiring assessment (e.g., storage or conference floors, etc.). Includes floors in fully and partially assessed assets.
Asset Details View

Clicking an asset in the Office Inventory opens the Asset Details View, showing a stacking diagram, asset information, and partner occupancy details.

Special Considerations

This field provides context about the asset or its occupancies, such as major construction underway or an assessment not required due to upcoming disposal or release.

Non-Numeric Values

N/A or N/R may be displayed in some data fields.

  • N/A: Assessment completed, but no primary workpoints present—often due to vacancy, decommissioning, or space not fit-up as office (e.g., SPS misidentified, conference room, etc.).
  • N/R: Region deemed assessment Not Required, typically due to upcoming disposal/release or security restrictions (e.g., Public Safety Special).
Fit-Up Type

The fit-up type of a given asset is determined by the fit-up type of its floors. Unless a floor's current (observed) fit-up differs from the fit-up captured in SIGMA, the latter is used. “Mixed” fit-up type indicates that floors of an asset are fit-up using multiple standards.

Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) Accommodated

The number of FTEs accommodated within an asset, as per active Lease-Out Contracts (also known as Occupancy Instruments).

Office Inventory

This section shows asset-level data, including occupancy details (as of November 3, 2025) and available primary workpoints.

Workpoint

Confirmed primary individual workpoints per asset. Primary individual workpoints are designed for focused activities with formal posture and mid- to long-term use. Each includes an adjustable task chair and may have monitors and/or a height-adjustable surface.

Primary Individual workpoint types can include: workstations, workpods, focus rooms or enclosed offices

About this dashboard
Last updated: March 4 2026

About this dashboard

This dashboard supports the National Strategic Portfolio Planning (NSPP) exercise to assess potential office space pressures arising from increased

The dashboard is based on SIGMA source data, the authoritative system of record, incorporating workpoint and fit-up information, all validated through regional review.

Calculations account for standard planning assumptions, and exclude non-office and Special Purpose Space.

Any data anomalies identified should be addressed through the National Reporting and Data Management's Business Intelligence Team.
